one_line: Paramēśvara of the Early Western Chalukyas, who checked Harsha on the Narmada frontier.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s to early 40s, athletic and broad-shouldered with a solid warrior’s build.
appearance.face: Oval face with high cheekbones, medium-deep brown Deccan complexion, straight nose, neatly kept moustache extending slightly past the corners of the mouth, small trimmed beard along the jawline, sharp steady eyes with a calm, assessing default expression conveying composed confidence.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair drawn back into a high, tight topknot (kudumi) at the crown, sides smooth and tidy; a narrow gold circlet with a central oval garnet-like stone rests low on the forehead, just touching the hairline, and a simple thin tilaka of red sandal paste runs vertically between the brows.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate Deccan royal-warrior attire: a knee-length, off-white cotton angavastra-style tunic with short sleeves and a subtle woven border, worn under a fitted, sleeveless, coppery-brown leather-like torso harness reinforced with small overlapping bronzed metal plates over the chest and upper back; a deep indigo cotton wrapped lower garment (dhoti-style) tightly pleated in front and reaching to mid-shin, bordered with a thin gold stripe; a wide, brick-red cloth waist sash wrapped firmly around the harness and knotted on his left hip with the free ends hanging to mid-thigh; a light, mustard-gold silk uttariya (shawl) draped from the left shoulder across the torso and looped under the right arm, pinned by a small round bronze brooch at the shoulder; sturdy brown leather sandals with simple straps; jewellery limited to a pair of small, round gold ear-studs, a single medium-thick gold necklace with a flat central pendant resting at the upper chest, and two plain bronze bangles on each wrist.
appearance.signature: A long, slightly curved iron sword with a simple bronze guard and a dark wooden hilt wrapped in braided cord, carried in a plain brown leather scabbard that hangs from a broad belt across his waist and rests against his left hip, often drawn and held upright with the blade reflecting light along its edge.

ref_desc: Pulakeshin II is a late-30s Deccan king with a brown complexion, black hair in a high topknot under a gold circlet, wearing an off-white tunic, coppery harness, deep indigo dhoti, mustard-gold shawl, brick-red sash, and carrying a curved sword at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Pulakeshin II, a late-30s Deccan monarch with an athletic build, brown complexion, oval face, high cheekbones, straight nose, and a neatly kept moustache with a small trimmed jawline beard, his default expression calm and confident; give him thick black hair pulled into a high tight topknot at the crown, sides smooth, with a narrow gold circlet bearing a central oval red stone resting low on his forehead and a thin vertical red tilaka between his brows. Dress him in an off-white knee-length cotton tunic with short sleeves and a subtle woven border, over which he wears a fitted sleeveless coppery-brown leather-like harness reinforced with small overlapping bronzed metal plates over chest and upper back. Wrap his lower body in a deep indigo dhoti-style garment reaching to mid-shin with a thin gold border, tightly pleated at the front, and cinch his waist with a wide brick-red cloth sash wrapped firmly and knotted on his left hip, the ends hanging to mid-thigh. Drape a light mustard-gold silk shawl from his left shoulder across his torso and under his right arm, pinned at the shoulder with a small round bronze brooch. Put sturdy brown leather sandals on his feet, simple round gold ear-studs on his ears, a single medium-thick gold necklace with a flat central pendant on his chest, and two plain bronze bangles on each wrist. At his left hip, show a long slightly curved iron sword in a plain brown leather scabbard hanging from a broad belt, and in at least one pose have him holding the drawn sword upright so the blade catches the light. Use a consistent palette of deep indigo, mustard gold, off-white, coppery brown, and brick red across the model sheet, showing front, side, and back views with clear views of hair, circlet, garments, and weapon.
